documents.subject: Settlement policy excerpt
documents.body:
Excerpt for same-day review, dated 2025-12-31:

“Only confirmed external movements are settled; proposals are not settlements.”

This excerpt is provided in connection with payroll record PAY-012 for Meridian Ledger Labs, Inc., company ID MERIDIAN-001. It does not establish an additional approval, payment, commercial term, or completed movement. Any operational use of this language should be accompanied by confirmation of the relevant external movement. Where confirmation or explanation is missing, the appropriate action is to request it and preserve the item as unresolved for review.
